title: Lazybox workspace runtime (.lazybox/workspace.yaml)
description: What a new workspace of this repository sets up, runs and archives. Lazybox shows these scripts and runs them only after you approve this exact version. See WORKSPACE_RUNTIME.md.

setup.description: Runs once in each new worktree, after the files are copied (npm ci, make deps, migrations).

archive.description: Runs before the workspace is deleted (drop a database, stop containers). Stopped after its timeout, 120 s by default.

files.description: Files to copy from the source checkout into each new worktree, for gitignored files a fresh checkout lacks (.env). Exact paths or patterns like config/*.local.json. Never overwrites a file the worktree already has.

env.description: Variables for every script and action of this repository.

actions.description: Named run scripts, in the order shown. One may be the default that Run starts.

run.description: The command to run, in your login shell. $LAZYBOX_PORT is this action's port.

default.description: Run starts this action. At most one.

concurrent.description: false: starting it stops the same action in every other workspace of this repository.

url.description: Where it serves, on this machine, for Preview: http://localhost:$LAZYBOX_PORT.

port.description: Which port of the workspace's block is this action's $LAZYBOX_PORT.

timeout.description: Seconds before the script is stopped.
